Contract EnterValidatedCreditReferencesModule::listSubmitedLoanRequest(): Set(LoanRequest) {
	definition:
		obs: Set(LoanRequest) = LoanRequest.allInstance()->select(o|o.Status = SUBMITTED)
	precondition:
		CurrentLoanRequests->forAll(o|obs->includes(o)) and
		obs->forAll(o|CurrentLoanRequests->includes(o)) and
		obs.isEmpty() = false
	postcondition:
		CurrentLoanRequests = obs
}
